objective: Prove the exact selected-backend constrained-decoding infrastructure is ready for the frozen six-case pilot without loading model weights or performing model inference.

model.preflight_rule: Weight files may be existence/size/hash verified as bytes. They must not be deserialized, mmap-loaded as model tensors, or passed to any AutoModel/model loader.

inference_config.note: These values are frozen for manifest/integration readiness only; no inference occurs in this slice.

authorized: load local tokenizer and model config metadata only with local_files_only=true
compile accepted XGrammar grammar against the pinned tokenizer
implement/freeze the exact XGrammar-to-Transformers constrained-decode adapter intended for PILOT-01
exercise the adapter using synthetic logits/tensors only
verify token masks, stop/completion behavior, reset/clone behavior, and deterministic state transitions
rerun accepted fixed positive/negative grammar and token-mask parity suites
render and hash the frozen zero-shot prompt using a non-sealed dummy smoke input
mechanically prepare per-case pre-inference hashes for the frozen six using only utterance + ProjectedWorkspace; do not expose oracle/gold material to the model-input path
verify the six use one identical prompt template, constraint artifact, serializer, and inference configuration
produce the complete pilot run manifest required by Q6 before any future inference
record environment/runtime/device/library provenance and bounded preflight resource evidence
add guards/tests proving model load, model forward, model generate, autodownload, retries, repair, and oracle-derived model input cannot occur

sealed_six_policy.purpose: manifest-only mechanical preparation; no model execution
sealed_six_policy.persist_raw_utterance_or_workspace: NO — hashes/provenance only in preflight evidence unless already part of existing frozen harness artifacts

synthetic_logits_integration.requirement: The exact future PILOT adapter must accept synthetic logits and apply the XGrammar hard mask without invoking a model.
prove: disallowed token logits are masked to the backend/adapter's impossible value
matcher advances only on accepted token ids
completion enables only permitted stop behavior
no semantic repair or post-hoc JSON fixing exists in the adapter

mandatory_gates.P1_identity: All frozen predecessor, grammar, lowerer, backend, tokenizer, config, and weight-file identities match.
mandatory_gates.P2_manifest: Complete Q6 MODEL/CONSTRAINT/PROMPT/WORKSPACE_SERIALIZATION/INFERENCE manifest is materialized before any future inference.
mandatory_gates.P3_prompt: Frozen zero-shot prompt/template hashes match; dummy chat-template/tokenization smoke passes; thinking disabled.
mandatory_gates.P4_constraint: XGrammar 0.2.8 compiles the exact accepted native grammar against the pinned tokenizer; accepted parity/mask corpus remains 100%.
mandatory_gates.P5_adapter: Exact intended pilot constraint adapter passes synthetic-logits hard-mask/completion/reset tests with no model.
mandatory_gates.P6_six_case_freeze: All six pre-inference hash records exist in frozen order and prove identical prompt/constraint/serializer/inference config; no forbidden fields enter model input.
mandatory_gates.P7_fail_closed: Pin/hash mismatch, backend error, adapter error, missing local artifact, or contamination check causes PREFLIGHT FAIL with model_calls=0.
mandatory_gates.P9_resources: Record compile/setup and synthetic-mask resource/latency evidence on the intended environment; no pathological failure.

forbidden: AutoModel.from_pretrained or any model-class weight loader

result_policy.pass: All P1-P9 PASS. This establishes infrastructure readiness only and does not authorize PILOT-01.
result_policy.fail: Any mandatory gate fails => PREFLIGHT FAIL / STOP. Do not repair by changing frozen prompt, grammar, serializer, model, tokenizer, or backend.
result_policy.next_if_pass: Independent SOL review, then Human acceptance/closure, then a separate explicit DECOMPOSER-PILOT-01 authority.
